title: Selling a Texas House With a Property Tax Deferral
description: Selling a Texas house with deferred homestead taxes? Find out what to ask the tax collector and title company before you count on your closing proceeds.
primaryKeyword: selling a Texas house with a property tax deferral
supportingKeywords: Fort Bend property tax deferral after selling
sellerQuestion: What happens to my existing Texas residence homestead tax deferral if I move out or sell?
substantiveDifference: Separates a filed §33.06 collection deferral from ordinary back taxes, a valuation protest and current-year proration. Gives the deferral-record, collector-notice and dated-payoff decision before selecting a buyer or committing to a move. Fresh main content, seller pages, pending PRs and topic ledger screened; no city variant.
serviceGeography: Greater Houston, Harris and Fort Bend, corroborated by current CashAsIs seller pages.

sellerVoice.limitations: Bounded anonymous SMS screen did not establish recurrence or demand for tax deferral. No identifying details, quotes or amounts accessed in output or retained.
